cases.name: cooley-three-methods
cases.description: The Cooley GO three-method pricing example: $8,000,000 pre-money, $2,000,000 new money, $1,000,000 of notes converting at a 30% discount, 1,000,000 pre-round fully diluted shares. Pre-money method: $8.00 round price, $5.60 conversion price, ownership 70% / 12.5% / 17.5%. Percentage-ownership method: $6.5714 (the article's $6.57), $4.60, ownership 65.71% / 14.29% / 20%. Dollars-invested method: $7.5714 ($7.57), $5.30, ownership 68.83% / 12.99% / 18.18%.
cases.source: Cooley GO, "Calculating Share Price With Outstanding Convertible Notes or Safes" (Derek Colla; https://www.cooleygo.com/calculating-share-price-outstanding-convertible-notes-or-safes/, last reviewed 2022-01-24)
